paragraphs: Two major sprout-related outbreaks have ended [1][2]. A Salmonella outbreak linked to broccoli sprouts affected 34 people across 6 states with 3 hospitalizations [1]. An E. coli and Salmonella outbreak linked to alfalfa sprouts sickened 77 people across 16 states with 6 hospitalizations [2].

EDEN BROTHERS is recalling Broccoli Seeds - Calabrese due to Salmonella contamination, distributed nationwide [4]. FORTUNA MARKETING is recalling ZestiGreens Broccoli Seeds for Sprouting & Microgreens due to potential Salmonella contamination, primarily distributed through Amazon [6]. GF Blends Inc is recalling Gluten Free Truly AIP Rustic Bread Mix (14 oz) sold online at eatgangster.com, trulyaip.com, and Amazon.com due to undeclared wheat gluten [3]. Oliva on Main is recalling Riad's Oliva to Go Hummus sold in Massachusetts and Connecticut due to undeclared sesame [5]. JXK Enterprises is recalling Boner Bears Chocolate distributed nationwide via elyxr.com because it contains the prescription drug sildenafil not listed on the label [7].

Family Farmstead Dairy recalled all cheddar cheese products due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination [12]. Fresh & Ready Foods recalled 2,414 Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches (4.6 oz) due to potential Listeria monocytogenes contamination [13].
